Former IAS Officer Sujata Karthikeyan Joins BJD in Odisha

Former IAS officer Sujata Karthikeyan, wife of VK Pandian, has joined the Biju Janata Dal (BJD) in Odisha. Her entry into politics has sparked discussions regarding Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik's succession plans. Karthikeyan was previously associated with the state's Mission Shakti program.
